parsed.root_cause: A scheduled Chaos Mesh network delay experiment targeting the product-catalog service was triggered, causing cascading latency and errors across dependent services.
evidence: K8s event 'Spawned' at 18:00:00Z indicates a Chaos Mesh Schedule named 'otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay' created a NetworkChaos object 'otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay-hcwrz'.
Multiple services (frontend, checkout, recommendation, product-catalog) show high latency (>1500ms) and non-zero error rates in alerts.
The chaos-mesh event explicitly targets the 'product-catalog' service with a network delay type.
